title: Priya Finance Ltd v. Ajay Kumar
text: This is a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. The complainant, Priya Finance Ltd, advanced a loan of Rs 8,00,000 to the accused, Ajay Kumar. The accused issued a cheque towards repayment which was dishonoured on presentation with the remark 'Account Closed'. The complainant duly issued a statutory legal demand notice within thirty days of dishonour. The drawer failed to make payment within the stipulated period. The defence raised by the drawer that the loan was fully repaid was not substantiated by any documentary evidence. The complainant produced bank statements and the original cheque with bank memo. The court finds that the dishonour of the cheque is established beyond reasonable doubt. The drawer is held guilty under Section 138 NI Act. Sentence: two years simple imprisonment with a fine of Rs 16,00,000 as double the cheque amount as compensation to the complainant under the Negotiable Instruments Act.
